verdict.rationale: The only first-party, language-level building surface in the evidence is the AWS CDK. It is an official open-source development framework in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C#/.NET and Go, with a reusable Construct Library, so AWS ships official multi-language code libraries. However, the CDK covers only infrastructure definition through CloudFormation, not calling AWS services from application code. The CLI and Cost Explorer API are not SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of general-purpose AWS service SDKs (e.g., per-language client libraries for calling S3, EC2 or Bedrock), SDK documentation depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
